# file-sharer

> Private, end-to-end encrypted sharing of text and files between your own devices.

## Product

- [file-sharer homepage](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/): Create or link a private space without an account.
- [Sitemap](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/sitemap.xml): Public URLs for the application.

## Key features

- Messages and files are encrypted on the device before they leave it.
- The server stores ciphertext, public keys and hashes rather than plaintext.
- Devices can be paired with a QR code and used offline as an installable PWA.
